verdict.rationale: Algolia is a hosted search SaaS with AI features (NeuralSearch, Recommend, Agent Studio, Personalization), so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documentation of a policy, setting, or contractual control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Completion caching and ML-based recommendations are adjacent features and do not address the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
